search_item_list.desc: Tattoo infections are uncommon but can occur if bacteria enter damaged skin. Warning signs may include spreading redness, swelling, pain, warmth, discharge, or feeling unwell. Proper hygiene, professional tattooing practices, and correct aftercare reduce risks. If symptoms are severe, worsening, or persistent, medical evaluation may be needed. #medicine #doctor #healthtips
